uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7272-8329--225.easyPrerequisites: The Zombie Cat doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and has base toughness 2 or greater.
6972-7272-8329--225.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
6972-7272-8329--225.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the Zombie Cat.
When the Zombie Cat dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Zombie Cat enters, Olag and Miau's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat.
Resolve the second trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on either a Zombie or Cat you control.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.
6972-7272-8329--225.notes: You can use either Olag and Miau trigger to put a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat. The other ability can put the counter on any Zombie or Cat you control depending on which trigger is left.

2638-3510-5929-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Leyline of Transformation.
2638-3510-5929-6705.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Leyline of Transformation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Tracker to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Tracker trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Quina.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

240-4050-5470-8201.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding one mana of any color
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

323-5170-6132-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

2724-3963-8172.notablePrerequisites: Meneldor cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2724-3963-8172.description:
Declare Meneldor as an attacker, attacking a player who cannot block it.
When Meneldor deals combat damage to a player, it triggers, blinking Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Karn.
Repeat each turn.

141-1854-2438.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1854-2438.description:
Cast Makeshift Mannequin by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Makeshift Mannequin.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Makeshift Mannequin
Resolve the Makeshift Mannequin copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: One-drop creature with a second body

671-1957-4050--204.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the one-drop creature, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, it and Daxos trigger.
Resolve the creature's ability, creating a creature token.
When the token enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the one-drop creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Daxos trigger from step 2, causing you to gain 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers; decline to use its ability unless you have excess mana to spend.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token creature, adding one colored mana.
Cast the creature by paying one mana.
When the creature enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers; decline to use its ability unless you have excess mana to spend.
Repeat.

225-851-1308-4094-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
225-851-1308-4094-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

3249-3967-5173-5921.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4029-4762-7741.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Benevolent Hydra and Shang-Chi.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

1733-4377-7722.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Nephalia Smuggler.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

413-6872-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
413-6872-7690--165.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2012-2921-6972.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist
When Strangleroot Geist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Strangleroot Geist
When Strangleroot Geist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Strangleroot Geist enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
2012-2921-6972.notes: If Strangleroot Geist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

246-1806-4050-7499.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Poxwalkers and Eternal Scourge, adding {1}{B/G}.
Activate Lluwen by exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, causing Lluwen to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Pest Friend by paying {B/G}.
Poxwalkers triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Pest Friend, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Poxwalkers and the Pest, adding {2}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

1322-2539-3094-4659-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
1322-2539-3094-4659-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1765-2034-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

5657-5664-5940.description:
Cast Writhing Chrysalis by paying {2}{R}{G}.
Writhing Chrysalis and Ulalek trigger.
Holding priority, cast Return the Favor by paying {1}{R}{R}, copying Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copied Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} and creating a copy of the Writhing Chrysalis spell, Writhing Chrysalis's trigger, and Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copied Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} and creating a copy of at least two Writhing Chrysalis spells, at least two Writhing Chrysalis's triggers, and Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve a Writhing Chrysalis trigger, creating two Eldrazi Spawn tokens.
Activate two Eldrazi Spawn tokens by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from 5 any number of times.
Once you have infinite copies of the spells and triggers, you can resolve them all, activate any number of Eldrazi Spawn tokens, and trigger all Writhing Chrysalis's final abilities.
5657-5664-5940.notes: You may also perform this combo with {C}{C} less starting mana, skipping step 5. This does not result in infinite colorless mana or infinite creature tokens.

109-232-1235-1809.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Fork by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Returned Pastcaller.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Returned Pastcaller with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Returned Pastcaller tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Fork from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1887-4013-7009.manaNeeded: {2}{C} plus an additional {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1887-4013-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Vorinclex.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

1829-5073-5220-6900.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Vindictive Vampire trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vindictive Vampire trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2770-5571-6797--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1263-5231-6462.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {R}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat

254-1497-3327-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
254-1497-3327-4613.description:
Cast First Day of Class by paying {1}{R}.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, First Day of Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Dargo.
Activate Dargo using Wild Cantor's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-3147-6517.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3147-6517.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, Dragonback Assault, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2425-5256-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2425-5256-6249--5.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Smothering Abomination trigger.
Resolve the Smothering Abomination trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

147-997-6475.description:
Cast Reunion of the House by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reunion of the House.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Reunion of the House, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Reunion of the House, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2919-5641-6458.easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2919-5641-6458.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
2919-5641-6458.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-2392-4321-5251.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Emmara and another artifact, targeting Emmara.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Emmara.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5147-5434-5555-6331.easyPrerequisites: Stiltzkin, Moogle Merchant does not have summoning sickness.
5147-5434-5555-6331.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
5147-5434-5555-6331.description:
Activate Stiltzkin by paying {2} and tapping it, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1753-3204-4251-4364.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Aurelia.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Aurelia or Godo must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
1753-3204-4251-4364.description:
Declare either Aurelia or Godo and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Aurelia or Godo trigger.
Resolve the Aurelia or Godo trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Aurelia or Godo from the battlefield, and then returning Aurelia or Godo from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1912-3525-4720-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Red Death.
1912-3525-4720-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

1069-3552-5223-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-3552-5223-5499.description:
Activate Blaring Recruiter by paying {2}{W}, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Warrior.
Activate the Warrior by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

1770-3657-4939.description:
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Burning-Tree Emissary to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Burning-Tree Emissary by paying {R/G}{R/G}.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

386-396-5064.notablePrerequisites:
Glistening Oil attached to Skirk Fire Marshal.
You control at least five untapped Goblins.
386-396-5064.description:
Activate Skirk Fire Marshal by tapping five untapped Goblins, giving each opposing creature ten -1/-1 counters and giving each opponent ten poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten poison counters.

3742-4125-4377.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
3742-4125-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons, taking an extra turn after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser that is tapped and attacking.
Shipwreck Dowser enters, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

3277-3617-4305.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Izzet Chronarch.
3277-3617-4305.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a copy of Izzet Chronarch.
Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, returning Time Walk to your hand.
Repeat.

406-4971.notablePrerequisites:
Tandem Lookout is paired with Niv-Mizzet.
Niv-Mizzet does not have summoning sickness.
406-4971.description:
Activate Niv-Mizzet's ability to draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
When Niv-Mizzet deals damage, its ability from Tandem Lookout triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
To end the loop and stop yourself drawing from an empty library, choose any target besides an opponent in step 2.
